subject: ICT
title: Let's Draw Looking the Sky
subtitle: Meet the computer, our new friend
hero_picture: A Kerala girl sitting on a hilltop at night looking at a starry sky with a crescent moon, a friendly cartoon laptop with a smiling face beside her.

sections.heading: Look at the sky
text: At night the sky is full of stars.
Ammu looks up and sees the moon too.
She wants to draw the stars.
sections.caption: A starry night sky
sections.picture: A night sky full of bright twinkling stars and a crescent moon over dark hills.

sections.heading: A new friend
text: A computer has come to join our friends.
It helps us play, sing and draw.
sections.caption: Our friend, the computer
sections.picture: A friendly cartoon laptop with a smiling face on its screen, waving at a little girl.

sections.heading: Using the mouse
text: We move the mouse with our hand.
A pointer moves on the screen.
Press the button once. That is a click!
sections.caption: Clicking the mouse
sections.picture: A child's hand holding a computer mouse on a desk, one finger pressing the left button.

sections.heading: Click and draw
text: Click on each blue circle in order.
The dots join to make a picture!
sections.caption: Join the dots on screen
sections.picture: A laptop screen showing a dark blue night sky with white dots joined by lines to make a star shape.

sections.heading: Show your picture
text: Ammu made a star on the screen.
Her friends made a moon and a tree.
sections.caption: Sharing our drawings
sections.picture: A happy girl and boy at a laptop showing their drawing of stars to their teacher.

rhyme: Twinkle stars up in the sky,
Click, click, click, my mouse can fly,
Dot by dot, a star I drew,
activity: Look at the sky tonight. Count the stars you see and draw them on paper.
talk: What did Ammu see in the sky?
What do we hold to click?
What appears when we join the dots?
summary: The computer is our new friend; we move the mouse and click to draw.

questions.prompt: What do we use to click on the computer?
questions.explanation: We press the mouse button to click.

questions.prompt: How many times do we press for one click?
questions.explanation: A click is one quick press.

questions.prompt: What shines in the night sky?
questions.explanation: Stars and the moon shine at night.

questions.prompt: In 'Click and Draw', what do we click on?
questions.explanation: We click on each blue circle in order.

questions.prompt: What happens when the dots are joined?
